---
title: "Jaisa Mera Maula Waisa Koi Nayi"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Ya Shah-e-Auliya Waris-e-Mustafa Ya Ali Murtaza Ya Ali Elia.

Koi Nayi Ali Jiya Koi Nayi Jaisa Mera Maula Waisa Koi Nayi.
Saqi-e-Kausar Shafa-e-Mehshar Koi Nahi Hai Tere Barabar.
Terah 13 Rajab Ko Ab Bhi Kaba Hans Kar Kehta Hai.
Main Woh Sadaf Hoon Arsh Ka Gohar Jis Mein Rehta Hai.

Mera Qibla Mera Kaba Mera Malik Mera Aaqa.
Dar Par Apne Tara Bulaya Soraj Paltaya.
Faqay Kar Ke Rizq Jahan Ko Oss Ne Pohanchaya.
Parh Kar Yeh Haider Ka Qaseeda Kehti Hain Khuda Fatima Zahra.

Khum Mein Nabi Ne Yeh Farmaya Haider Haider Kar.
Bach Ja Momin Parh Le Kalma Haider Haider Kar.
Jo Bhi Kar Le Qabar Se Bahir Ho Ga Teri Qabar Ke Andar.
Pani Aap Darakht Nu La Ke Kita Si Teyar.

Ishq-e-Ali Di Meesum Keeti Fair Jari Guftar.
Jini Wari Khanjar Chaliya Onni Wari Meesum Dasiya.
Qaid Nahi Hai Iss Mein Koi Shia Suni Ki.
Wajib Hai Har Ik Pe Muhabbat Mere Bhai Ki.

Maan Ke Sab Yeh Qaul-e-Payamber Dil Se Pukaro Haider Haider.
Koi Nayi Koi Nayi Koi Nayi Jaisa Mera Maula Waisa Koi Nayi.
Azal Se Aik Hi Manzar Hai Meri Aankhon Mein.
Main Kaisay Khana-e-Kaba Kissi Taraf Dekhon.

Tu Khud Bhi Ishq Ki Majboriyaan Samjhta Hai.
Najaf Se Aankh Hatay Tu Teri Taraf Dekhon.
Shah-e-Wilayat Shams-e-Imamat Qasim-e-Janat Kun Ki Haqeeqat.
Koi Nayi Koi Nayi Koi Nayi Jaisa Mera Maula Waisa Koi Nayi.

Shams, Bhittai, Sachal, Bahu, Khawaja, Ajmeri,.
Maula Tere Naam Ki Mala Japtay Hain Sab Hi.
Kar Ke Dhamalein Wajad Mein Aa Kar Kehta Hai Yeh Lal Qalandar.
Dama Dam Mast Qalandar Hussaini Lal Qalandar Ali Da Pehla Number.

Aflak Se Layi Jati Hai Seeno Mein Chupayi Jati Hai.
Tauheed Ki May Sagar Se Nahi Aankhon Se Pilayi Jati Hai.
Saqiya Saqiya Saqiya Our Pila Our Pila Our Pila,.
Saqiya Our Pila Our Pila Our Pila,.
Saqiya Our Pila Our Pila Our Pila.
Har So Rawaan Hawa-e-Khumar-e-Tarab Hai Aaj.
Baab-e-Qabool Wa Hai Muradoon Ki Shab Hai Aaj.
Dil Mein Khushi Surror Nazar Mein Ajab Hai Aaj.
Saqi Mujhe Na Chair Ke Terah 13 Rajab Hai Aaj.
Rukh Se Naqab Utha Ke Naveed-e-Zahoor De.
Hazir Hai Dil Ka Jaam Sharab-e-Tahoor De.
Woh May Pila Ke Jis Mein Nabowat Ki Bo Miley.
Jis Ke Nashay Mein Husan-e-Imamat Ki Kho Miley.
Aadam Ko Jis Se Khoyi Hoi Aabro Miley.
Main Bhi Piyon Tu Mujh Ko Khuda Robaro Miley.
Woh May Ke Jis Mein Subh-e-Azal Ka Surror Ho.
Woh May Ke Jis Mein Aal-e-Muhammad Ka Noor Ho.
Kal Ke Liye Kar Aaj Na Khisat Sharab Mein.
Yeh Soye Zan Hai Saqi-e-Kausar Ke Baab Mein.
 Ghalib Nadeem-e-Dost Se Aati Hai Bo-e-Dost.
Mashgool-e-Haq Hoon Bandagi-e-Buturab Mein.
Khum Diyaan Galaan Das Ke Ayho Kehnda Aye Salman.
Minber Khas Banawan Kitay Le Le San Palaan.
Pak Nabi Ne Bazu Maula Kaun Aye Khud Samjhaya.
Koi Nayi Koi Nayi Koi Nayi Ali Jiya Koi Nayi.

Gaud Mein Le Kar Kalma Sunaya:MIR TAKALLUM: Ko.
Maa Ne Sabaq Yeh Pehla Parhaya:MIR TAKALLUM: Ko.
Beta Hamesha Yaad Yeh Rakhna Mujh Se Zyada Haq Hai Ali Ka.
Koi Nayi Koi Nayi Koi Nayi Ali Jiya Koi Nayi.
